name: check_flow
title: Check a flow
description:
Lists everything the flow builder would flag on a flow: each issue's severity (an `error` blocks
switching it on, a `warning` never does), a plain message, and the card, trigger, outcome or field it is
about. No issues means nothing to fix. Drafts and live flows alike. `get_flow_health` says how its runs
went; `read_flow` shows its cards.
